Detect the Exact Time (hour and minute; hm) of Daylight Saving Time (DST) Change

Source: R/daylight_saving.R
dst_switch_hm.Rd

Identifies the precise local time when a DST transition occurs on a given date in a specified time zone.

Usage

dst_switch_hm(date, tz = tz2(), interval = 1)

Arguments

date

A string in "YYYY-MM-DD" format or a Date object.

tz

A valid time zone name (default is "America/Vancouver"), used to determine DST rules. Use OlsonNames() to see all valid options.

interval

An integer (1–59) specifying the time resolution in minutes used to detect DST changes (default: 1, meaning 1 minute). You almost never need to change this.

Value

A POSIXct object indicating the time just before the DST transition. If no DST change is detected on the specified date, the function returns NULL with a warning.

Details

The function detects DST changes using differences in DST status across time intervals during the given date. It handles "skipped" or "duplicated" times (as occurs during spring and fall transitions) using both dst() and NA time gaps. In the case of ambiguous or unresolvable transitions, NULL is returned with a warning.

Examples

dst_switch_hm("2020-03-08", tz = "America/Vancouver")
#> [1] "2020-03-08 01:59:00 PST"
dst_switch_hm("2020-11-01", tz = "America/Vancouver")
#> [1] "2020-11-01 00:59:00 PDT"
dst_switch_hm("2020-07-01", tz = "Etc/UTC") # No DST change
#> Warning: No DST transition detected on this date in the specified time zone.
#> NULL
